plates.name: gestures-sheet
plates.prompt: Instruction-manual pictogram sheet: eight hand-shape line drawings arranged in an exact grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, equal cells, each hand centred in its cell with generous margin, on a flat pure black background. Each drawing is one human hand seen from the palm side, fingers pointing up, drawn as clean continuous off-white line art of one even medium stroke weight, like a technical illustration in a musical-instrument manual. Anatomically correct, exactly five digits on every hand, no shading, no fill, no colour, no text, no numbers, no labels, no cell borders. Row 1, left to right: (1) open hand with all five fingers spread apart; (2) closed fist with the thumb wrapped across the front of the fingers; (3) only the index finger pointing straight up, the other fingers curled, thumb folded over them; (4) peace sign, index and middle fingers up in a V, ring and little finger curled, thumb folded over them. Row 2, left to right: (5) index, middle and ring fingers up, little finger curled, thumb folded over it; (6) thumbs up, a fist with the thumb pointing straight up; (7) rock sign, index and little finger up, middle and ring fingers curled, thumb folded across them; (8) hang-loose sign, thumb and little finger fully extended outward, the other three fingers curled into the palm.
plates.notes: a1: ACCEPT: all 8 cells verified at full resolution in order - (1) open 5 digits spread, (2) fist thumb across fingers, (3) index up + 3 curled + thumb over, (4) V + ring/little curled + thumb over, (5) index/middle/ring up + little curled + thumb over it, (6) thumbs-up (drawn side-on) 4 curled + thumb up, (7) rock index+little up, middle/ring curled, thumb across, (8) hang-loose thumb+little out, 3 curled; exactly 5 digits on each. Deviation: generator drew thin cell-border rules despite 'no cell borders' - process-art.mjs detects them (columns/rows >60% ink), uses them as the grid and erases them (+-4px), so the slices are clean. Mixed handedness across cells (cells 3/4 read as left hand) - acceptable for pictograms. | Sliced by process-art.mjs: grid taken from the detected border rules, rules erased, each drawing centred in a 706px square (largest drawing 588px + 10% pad) so all eight share one scale, then 320px with alpha = line luminance and RGB = #EDEBE6. Order: open, fist, index, peace, three, thumb, rock, hangloose.
